lessons.title: The Toy Machine
lessons.blurb: Draw a map, freeze a brick, run it every frame.

chapters.title: Hello
chapters.text: Welcome to Grove! Think of it like a toy machine. You draw a treasure map. Grove freezes that map into a hard brick. Then a little robot reads the brick every frame and makes the game world move.

chapters.title: The main path
chapters.text: Follow the bright path. First you draw. Then the importer makes cards. Then the bake oven freezes everything into one brick called Graph Data. That brick is what play time uses.

chapters.title: Helpers
chapters.text: Two helpers sit beside the path. Numbers on each box pick which door the robot opens. The backpack called Grove State remembers secrets between frames, like inputs and local variables.

chapters.title: Three rooms
chapters.text: There are three rooms. Draw time is Graph Toolkit. Bake time freezes the brick. Play time is your E C S system. Never mix the rooms up. The pretty map is not the brick.

api.short: The brick itself. Blob asset Graph Data.
api.deep: Blob Asset Reference Graph Data: Root, Inputs, Outputs, node maps, Graph Id.

auth.short: Numbers. Each node type is an integer door key.
auth.deep: Node Type integer. Grove Execution Types negatives for built-ins; your positives for customs.

cache.short: Backpack. Grove State on the entity.
cache.deep: Buffer container of Grove State. Get State extension returns the entity map.

cdn.short: Importer. Turns the pretty map into auth cards.
cdn.deep: Grove Importer Scripted Importer of T Auth. Creates auth subassets.

db.short: Robot brain. Your context with component bags.
db.deep: I Context of T partial struct. Component and Buffer containers wired by the generator.

lb.short: Bake oven. Freezes cards into a brick.
lb.deep: Graph Baking System. Auto-spawned; hashes variants and instance overrides.

queue.short: Play room. Your I System tick.
queue.deep: Graph Impl Get Execution then job Set Chunk and Execute or Calculate.

s3.short: Editor room. Graph Toolkit lives here.
s3.deep: Editor assembly boundary. Graph Toolkit Graph Database assets.

users.short: You draw the pretty map here. This is the source graph people edit.
users.deep: Source asset. Grove Graph subclass with a Graph attribute extension such as my graph.

worker.short: Do the work. Leaf methods move transforms and scores.
worker.deep: Static methods with Execute Node or Data Node attributes. Context by ref.

lessons.title: Draw → Bake → Play
lessons.blurb: Source map → importer → auth asset → bake → brick.

chapters.title: Hello
chapters.text: Welcome to the cooking show. Recipe is your map. Oven is the baker. Dinner plate is the robot tick. Same three steps every time.

chapters.title: Main path
chapters.text: You draw the pretty map. The importer builds an Auth box — a frozen card deck of Root, inputs, outputs, and nodes. Authoring on an entity only points at that Auth box. The bake oven reads the Auth box and freezes a brick. Play never opens the pretty map again.

chapters.title: Start door
chapters.text: The start door rule: exactly one Input wire must touch the first action box. Zero starts or two starts means the importer yells.

chapters.title: Extras
chapters.text: Variants pick a branch while baking, so unpicked paths disappear from the brick. The backpack holds live memory after bake.

approval.short: Start door check. The Auth box only gets a Root if exactly one Input boundary connects to an execution node.
approval.deep: CollectRootCandidates: exactly one Input variable resolving to GroveExecutionAuth.

blocked.short: Import error path. Fix the wires.
blocked.deep: Import validation failure for entry shape.

chat.short: Pretty map. Graph Toolkit source you edit. Humans draw here; bakers do not read this file at runtime.
chat.deep: GroveGraph source asset (.mygraph). Editor only. Not the baker input.

external.short: Bake oven. Reads the Auth box, applies variants and overrides, freezes a GraphData brick.
external.deep: GraphBakingSystem. Calls Auth.Create with instance values and variant selection.

final.short: It runs. Robot can Execute the brick.
final.deep: I Graph Reference Graph property holds the blob.

planner.short: Importer. Reads the pretty map once and builds the Auth box plus node sub-cards.
planner.deep: GroveImporter ScriptedImporter. Creates auth subassets and sets Root from Input boundary candidates.

retry.short: Reimport after you fix the start door.
retry.deep: Reimport after fixing Input to execution wiring.

router.short: Auth box is the imported result of your pretty map. After import, Grove no longer needs the drawing file for bake. This box holds the start Root, Inputs, Outputs, and every node as little cards. Authoring on a GameObject points here — not at the .mygraph.
router.deep: GroveAuthGraph: ScriptableObject main asset produced by GroveImporter. Fields Root, Inputs, Outputs, Nodes. GraphAuthoring references this asset. GroveAuthGraph.Create builds BlobAssetReference of GraphData.

store.deep: Dictionary of Grove Variant Auth to selected branch.

tool.short: Authoring component on a GameObject. Its job is only to point at an Auth box and optional overrides, then bake.
tool.deep: GraphAuthoring of TAuth comma TComponent. References Auth, registers bake deps, writes GraphBakingData.

trace.short: Backpack and overrides live near play.
trace.deep: Instance values and Grove State initialize bake.

user.short: You. The designer who wants a brain on the entity.
user.deep: Author intent. Creates Grove Graph asset.

lessons.title: One Frame
lessons.blurb: One system tick: GraphImpl, SetChunk, Execute.

chapters.title: What a frame is
chapters.text: A frame is one heartbeat of the game. Your system wakes, hands the robot a remote for this frame, points its bags at a group of entities, then walks the brick starting at Root.

chapters.title: Wake the robot
chapters.text: Get Execution is not a full rebuild. It refreshes generated handles, stamps time and logger into Grove Context, and returns a Graph Execution value. That value is a copy of the context bag for this update.

chapters.title: Walk the brick
chapters.text: Set Chunk first. That aims Component Container and Buffer Container at this Archetype Chunk. Then Execute starts at Root. Each box has a Type number. The door book opens that case and runs a static method.

chapters.title: Side effects and questions
chapters.text: Leaf methods write things like Local Transform. Data boxes sleep until something calls Calculate. If you Set Input first, you wrote a variable into the backpack. The graph reads it later. It is not a stack argument to Root.

api.short: Graph Impl. Keeps the context warm across frames.
api.deep: GraphImpl of MyContext. CreateGenerated wires containers from SystemState.

auth.short: Graph Execution for this update. Remote control for one tick.
auth.deep: GraphExecution of MyContext. Field Context is the bag nodes receive by ref.

db.short: Type switch. Generated Execution Generated on your context.
db.deep: ExecutionGenerated switch cases keyed by header.Type.

redis.short: The brick. Blob Asset Reference of Graph Data.
redis.deep: IGraphReference.Graph blob. GraphId scopes GroveState keys.

trace.short: A static method with Execute Node. Does the actual work.
trace.deep: Your [ExecuteNode] method. Prefer in payload, in GroveContext, ref MyContext.

user.short: Entities in the world. The job loops them after Set Chunk.
user.deep: Entity handle array from the chunk. Paired with entityIndexInChunk for containers.

web.short: Your I System. Owns Graph Impl for the whole system lifetime.
web.deep: ISystem with WorldSystemFilter as needed. RequireForUpdate any graph component you query.

lessons.title: Brick Anatomy
lessons.blurb: What lives inside GraphData — header, payload, Type.

chapters.title: Hello
chapters.text: The brick is a sandwich factory. Shell on the outside. Each box is bread plus filling. Little arrows point to kid boxes.

chapters.title: Shell
chapters.text: Outside: Graph Id stamps the backpack keys. Root is the start door. Inputs and Outputs are the labeled holes.

chapters.title: Box
chapters.text: Every node: bread is Type and Node Id. Filling is payload like Speed or score lists. Kids are blob pointers.

chapters.title: Doors
chapters.text: Robot reads Type, opens that door in the door book, runs the method, maybe follows more arrows, maybe writes the world.

consent.deep: Payload immediately after header via unsafe address offset.

dashboard.short: E C S write. Side effects.
dashboard.deep: Component Container Get R W using Entity Index In Chunk.

edge.short: Bread. Type number and Node Id.
edge.deep: Execution Header or Data Header. I Node Type and Node Id.

mobile.short: Inputs and Outputs list on the shell.
mobile.deep: Graph Input Data and Graph Output Data arrays.

model.deep: Graph State Util Get Variable and Set Variable.

pii.short: Kid arrows. Blob pointers to children.
pii.deep: Blob Array of Blob Ptr headers inside payload structs.

stream.short: Door book entry. Generated switch case.
stream.deep: I Context Generator Execution Generated and Data Generated.

warehouse.deep: Execute Node or Data Node target method.

web.deep: Blob Ptr Execution Header Root. May be invalid for pure Calculate graphs.

lessons.title: The Door Book
lessons.blurb: Source-gen writes the switch; the brick only stores numbers.

chapters.title: Compile vs play
chapters.text: The brick only stores numbers. Someone has to write a book that says what number forty two means. That book is generated when your project compiles, onto your partial Context type.

chapters.title: What it hunts
chapters.text: It finds your partial struct that implements I Context. It finds static methods with Execute Node or Data Node attributes. It also peeks into Grove for public built-in toys like Composite.

chapters.title: What it writes
chapters.text: Create Generated, Update Generated, and Set Chunk Generated wire your component bags. Then big switches: Execution Generated and Data Generated. Debug doors appear only when instrumentation is on.

chapters.title: Play time
chapters.text: Play never invents methods. Header Type selects a case. That case calls your static method with payload rehydrated from bytes after the header. Unknown Type becomes a no-op or default value.

api.deep: partial struct MyContext : IContext of MyContext.

auth.short: Methods with Execute Node or Data Node attributes.
auth.deep: ExecuteNodeAttribute and DataNodeAttribute with integer type ids.

db.short: Generated partial. The door book itself.

redis.short: Grove.dll. Built-in node methods get pulled into your switch.
redis.deep: Built-ins such as Composite and selectors with negative GroveExecutionTypes.

trace.short: Runtime switch. Type integer to method call.

user.short: You write Context and node methods in your assemblies.
user.deep: Your runtime assembly with partial MyContext and node classes.

lessons.title: Push vs Pull
lessons.blurb: Execute pushes control flow; Calculate pulls data.

chapters.title: Two play styles
chapters.text: Push starts at Root and walks action boxes. Pull starts at an Output and asks a data box for a value. Most graphs use both: selectors push, but they pull scores on the way.

chapters.title: Push path
chapters.text: Root may enter a Composite that runs every child. A Selector scores options, picks one action, executes it. The leaf finally moves the world. Nothing magic loops the whole brick each frame.

chapters.title: Pull path
chapters.text: Calculate on an Output evaluates only the data chain needed. Variables read the backpack. Qualifiers fold floats. If nothing asks, those boxes stay asleep.

chapters.title: Backpack between frames
chapters.text: Inputs, locals, and state machine ints live in Grove State on the entity. Keys include Graph Id. When one graph ends, remove only that Graph Id's keys so other graphs keep their memory.

approval.short: An Output or data question. Pull entry.

cancelled.short: Next frame will Get Execution again.

completed.short: World changed this frame for that entity.
completed.deep: ECS mutations already applied this tick.

executing.short: Selector. Pull scores, push one action.

expired.short: Same entity still holds Grove State.

planning.short: Composite. Run every connected execution child in order.

queued.short: Root. Push starts here for execution graphs.

lessons.title: Make a Toy
lessons.blurb: Four pieces of a custom node from editor to method.

chapters.title: Hello
chapters.text: Every custom toy has four LEGO pieces: data struct, auth card, draw node, and run method. Grove glues them with numbers.

chapters.title: Four pieces
chapters.text: Data holds Speed. Auth serializes it. Draw node is what you see in Graph Toolkit. Run method is the static C sharp with the attribute.

chapters.title: Wire
chapters.text: Importer copies draw fields into auth. Bake packs header plus payload. Use With Graph scopes the node to your map type.

chapters.title: Play
chapters.text: At play, Type hits your case in the door book. Method gets payload, Grove Context, and your context by ref. Then it mutates the world.
